name: Binary Document Ingestion & Parsing
description: Ingests and parses PDFs, PowerPoint decks (.pptx), Word documents (.docx), and Excel spreadsheets (.xlsx), extracting clean text and structural elements.

name: RAG Document Retrieval & Context Passing
description: Performs hybrid BM25 and semantic search over ingested document chunks, returning ranked passages with confidence scores and source citations.

name: Schema Ingestion & Parsing
description: Ingests raw text, JSON, YAML, and CSV files, automatically validating syntax and inferring structural data schemas.

name: Tabular Data Profiling
description: Profiles CSV tables, detects delimiters, verifies rectangular column consistency, and infers primitive data types.

name: Log & Syntax Anomaly Detection
description: Scans log files, server outputs, and source code for syntax breaks, formatting irregularities, and AST violations.
